_comments._usage: Shared BOARD FIRMWARE and browser preview configuration. Rebuild and flash after changing settings to update the board; reload local Studio for preview changes. _comments contains documentation, not settings.
_comments.update_ms: Integer 1..60000 milliseconds between generations. Smaller = faster. Examples: 250 = about 4 generations/second; 500 = about 2.
_comments.time_hold_seconds: Integer 0..59 seconds the completed clock stays fixed as a separate overlay after the minute changes. The game underneath never pauses. Afterwards live clock pixels merge into the game without erasing underlying cells.
_comments.clear_every_minutes: Allowed integers: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30, 60. Clear the underlying game at these minute boundaries, independently of the overlay. 15 = :00/:15/:30/:45; 30 = :00/:30; 60 = :00.
_comments.fade_after_seconds: Integer 0..86400 seconds a game cell must remain continuously alive before dimming. 0 = fade immediately. Death/rebirth resets age; merging the time starts new ages only for previously dead cells.
_comments.fade_duration_seconds: Integer 1..86400 seconds to fade from full brightness to black, then remove the cell from the simulation. Total lifetime = fade_after_seconds + fade_duration_seconds.
_comments.color: Hex RGB string #RRGGBB. Solid cell color when gradient is none; otherwise the gradient start color. Example #94e780 = light green. Overrides the cellular widget color picker.
_comments.gradient: Allowed strings: none = solid; horizontal = left to right; vertical = top to bottom; both = average of horizontal and vertical position, a top-left to bottom-right diagonal.
_comments.gradient_end_color: Hex RGB string #RRGGBB used at the far end of the gradient. Ignored when gradient is none. Example #44c6cb = cyan.
_comments.time_reverse_frames: Integer 0..120 forward Life generations of the incoming clock, played backwards before the minute changes. Lead-in = frames * update_ms; 8 * 500 ms = 4 seconds. 0 disables the lead-in. Lead-in plus hold must fit within 60 seconds.
